p, k = map(int, input().split())
used = [False] * p
t = 0

def dfs(x):
    used[x] = True
    to = (x * k) % p
    if not used[to]:
        dfs(to)

for i in range(p):
    if not used[i]:
        t += 1
        dfs(i)

ans = 1
for i in range(1, t + (1 if k == 1 else 0) + 1):
    ans = (ans * p) % 1000000007

print(ans)
